protocol.architecture: 73 inputs -> 128 SiLU -> 128 SiLU -> 128 SiLU -> EV/strategy heads, 8 slots each
protocol.sampling: uniform without replacement within each board/node positive-reach population; multiply training weights by population/sample count; fixed per-board/node seeds
protocol.baseline_fit: all training rows with actor-reach x board-frequency weights; B0 uses unweighted mean only for entirely zero-weight cells
protocol.evaluation: every row in every held-out file, weighted and unweighted; no evaluation row subsampling
protocol.equity: batch exact flop enumeration vs fixed root range; no solved deeper reach feature
